== Walkthrough ==
The instance start point is behind the flaming gate east of Diviner's Reach, where you completed The Sacrifice. Defeat the Forged standing in your way, then go to where your companions are and examine the Forged artifacts. You can even safely turn on the Branded cannon without blowing yourself up.
Talk to your group and move in the indicated direction. Defeat the Branded that appear in the canyon, and a number of purple lights appear. Pick up these crystal essences to hear some of Glint's memories. Move east, collecting more crystal essences, and talk to Rytlock for some lore. Kasmeer and Canach will move to the northeast and southwest corner around the caldera respectively, and point out the location of other crystals. Then get on your mounts and collect the essences on the ledges above you (most will need the springer to reach, some will need the raptor), fighting or evading the Branded that appear. After you've gathered 5 essences, you'll be glowing and will have the  Crystal Charge effect; return to Rytlock (or any of the crystals pointed to by the team) to hear more of Glint's memories.
Tour the edge of the caldera counterclockwise to pick up more crystal essences, using your mounts (and glider, if you have it) to get to them. Each time you collect 5 you can go to one of the memory crystals to hear more from Glint. After activating the third crystal, a portal will open at the bottom of the caldera. Enter it.
Now inside Glint's lair, examine the big spear to make a Facet Guardian appear. The guardian will use lots of AoE attacks and has two special mechanics you must overcome.

At the beginning it will use Crystalline Drain, an enormous AoE attack. To defend against this attack, defeat the Facets of Light that spawn during this time. They will drop bright orbs that you can collect to gain a shield that will protect you from the drain AoE, allowing you to continue to attack the boss.
From 75% health it will switch to putting a large dark shield on itself, that will reduce damage to almost nothing. Around the edge of the arena will be several Facets of Darkness. Defeat these to get dark orbs which will give you a special action skill: Crystalline Shatter. This skill will stun the boss and disrupt the shield, allowing you to continue damaging it
From 25% health the boss will use both of these together. Gather both facets of light and darkness. Then go toward the boss without getting hurt, avoiding all the AOE spam. When you get near it, activate the special skill and it will deal major damage to the Guardian. Repeat as necessary.
Once the guardian is defeated, go to the Intact Memory Crystal to hear more from Glint, then destroy the Dragonblood Spear and talk to your friends to complete the mission.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the instance.

In addition to the 15 essences required to open Glint's lair, there will be 5 extra essences across the crater. Collect all 20 essences to get this achievement.
The number of essences remaining can be tracked via  Qualify for All the Essences effect.

Open the portal to Glint's Lair within 2.5 minutes. You will need to collect a total of 15 essences—five per crystal—in this time. This may be easier in a group.
It is ideal to immediately equip the springer after the first memory crystal forms and head to the first set of essences (where Rytlock goes). The essences will appear once he gets into position. Use the raptor or jackal to get from one memory crystal to another fastest.
Note that you do not need to wait through dialogue after reconstructing a memory crystal—you can just move on to the next.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Dragon's Lair effect.

The simplest way to complete this achievement is to keep at range from the center of the arena. Do not run into the center if the Facet Guardian approaches you; it will always teleport back to the center to cast Crystalline Drain. You will be forced to run into Crystalline Drain during the final phase of the fight, however, so be sure to pick up a Facet of Light before running in.

== Walkthrough ==
Travel to Vehtendi Arena to start the instance, and talk to your team. Rytlock gives you his sword Sohothin, which comes with its own skills. The skills (2) and (3) reduce the cooldown of the powerful skills (4) and (5).
Join up with your undead forces to await Balthazar's assault. As the Forged appear, use Sohothin to help put them down. Eventually, Balthazar's Warbeast breaks open the gate. Follow it, taking down the Forged Assembler boss in your way by destroying his three shield generators and then himself.
Follow the indicated path on a Skimmer until you arrive at another battlefield. Again, destroy the Forged Assembler after taking out his shield generators. Mount up and follow the Warbeast on the indicated path, jumping the canyon on your Raptor. Continue taking out Forged Assemblers, while otherwise leaving the Branded and Forged to fight each other. Use your Springer as required to progress.
Eventually you catch up with the Warbeast at the top of the pyramid. Destroy it, prioritizing the regularly summoned Forged and shield generators. It is much easier to avoid the copious AoE attacks during this fight — first only from the Warbeast, later from Kralkatorrik as well — with the use of a ranged weapon instead of Sohothin. (You can switch to your own weapons by dropping the bundle using the Switch Weapons button/keybind. It then turns into the special action skill Unsheathe Sohothin.)
In addition to the Warbeast's telegraphed attacks, watch out for the following:

From time to time it spins around, and smashes the ground in front with its tail. To avoid this, use a long range weapon (eg. longbow) and attack from around one of the front corners (rather than from the center), or dodge roll when the Warbeast starts to spins.
In later phases it sometimes tiptoes to one side of the combat area, and shoots a laser on the other side. Immediately follow the Warbeast to the side that it moved to, as the laser turns the entire other half of the area into dark flames that instantly down you.
Avoid moving under the Warbeast's trunk. If you do, it drops down on you, immediately downing you. If you're still under it a few seconds later, it drops on you again, killing you.
Note, however, that the respawn if you die is at the entrance to the room.
The mission ends when you finish off the Warbeast, but you are then immediately thrust into your final confrontation with Balthazar.


=== Achievements ===

This achievement can be completed in the same run as Destroy Additional Pylons, though it will be easier if you skip the optional pylons (w/o Assemblers).
Required pylons can be killed more rapidly using mount damage.  If you have access to a skyscale, its fireball does ~80% of a pylon's health per shot, and can be used to weaken or even kill every pylon before engaging the Assembler miniboss in each area.
Note that if you kill pylons with mount damage, they will not count for Destroy Additional Pylons.
The only targets you need to kill are the Assembler miniboss, and any pylons protecting it.  Once the Assembler is down, you can run forwards past the rest of the Forged until you break combat and can mount up again.
Credit is given a few seconds after Balthazar finishes his speech and exclaims "You took advantage of Grenth's absence to escape the Domain of the Lost, but your resurrection is over", so make sure there is at least ~30s left on the timer before arriving at the top of the pyramid.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Beastcatcher effect.

There are 21 pylons in total:
3 around the first Assembler mini-boss
7 around the second Assembler, after the Skimmer quicksand section
4 around the third Assembler, after the Raptor cliff jump section
3 at intervals between the first Springer stable and the first wall requiring a Springer to scale, the last of which protecting the fourth Assembler.
3 at intervals on the level after jumping up the above wall, the middle of which protecting the fifth Assembler.
1 final pylon protecting the sixth Assembler, after using a Springer to jump up the final wall/scaffold, immediately before the staircase up to the Warbeast fight.
If a pylon is killed entirely via mount damage, including a Skyscale's fireball, it won't count for the achievement.
A skyscale's fireball does ~80% of a pylon's health in damage, so one fireball can be used on each without losing eligibility.
As long as the killing blow is done using Sohothin or your own weapons, it will count.
If the story instance is entered as a team, each member is required to damage every pylon in order for them to get the achievement.
Achievement is awarded upon entering conversation with Balthazar at the end of this chapter, immediately prior to fighting the Warbeast.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Destroy Additional Pylons effect.
Note that the achievement qualification effect will not be removed if a pylon is destroyed entirely via mount damage, but the achievement will still not be awarded.

This achievement involves crossing the quicksand in such a way that you don't touch any of the Branded Crystals that popup and act as landmines.
Since the skimmer is quite hard to control, if you are having difficulty you could pair up with a mesmer player who can portal you (in multiple steps) from one end of the quicksand to the other.
It is possible to avoid the Branded Crystals altogether while still maintaining eligibility for the achievement by going through/above the buildings to the left, then transitioning to the centre area using gliding skills. However, be aware that the area close to Tournament Battlegrounds is considered to be quicksand, so it is best to stay on the ground and not on top of the structures in that area.
Absolutely trivialized with a skyscale, as there are multiple buildings along the side of the quicksand that the skyscale can use to refresh flight endurance.
Achievement is awarded upon passing through the area immediately after the first area of quicksand (if using a Skyscale mount, you need to land immediately after the quicksand).
Achievement qualification may be tracked via  Speed Bumps effect.

== Walkthrough ==
Outside Amnoon
After meeting up with Taimi and Rytlock, head back towards Amnoon. As you cross the bridge leading to the refugee camp, you'll find a group of civilians who have been trapped inside a Branding Crystal. Rytlock will instruct you to save them, but the people inside this one are a lost cause. Push deeper into the camp and destroy the three crystals with red timer circles above them. When they're destroyed — whether you killed them or the timers ran out — it will be time to move on. Head west, pausing briefly to deal with the Brandstone Elementals that spawn to attack, towards Amnoon Water Authority, where there will be five more Branding Crystals to destroy. When these are down, head north to the gate into Amnoon, and fight another cluster of Brandstone Elementals.
The gate will open and you will be greeted by Canach, who joins your party.

Inside Amnoon
There will be three Death-Branded Lieutenants to defeat when you enter, each of them protected by an Empowering Crystal which must be destroyed first. All three lieutenants are at ground level; one crystal is next to its lieutenant, while the other two are atop walls to the east and west. When these are down, head north to fight Death-Branded Deputy Qais. Destroy his crystal and take him down. There are two more crystals and lieutenants atop the east and north border walls; when these are dead, the Branded Wyvern will spawn.

Branded Wyvern fight
The wyvern has an extreme amount of health, and even players with high damage must be ready for a long fight. Most of the wyvern's attacks are telegraphed, stunning and dealing high damage in a large area of effect. The wyvern also has delayed point-blank attacks that deal just as much damage but are not telegraphed. Move quickly or dodge at the right time to avoid getting hit. The wyvern doesn't inflict very many conditions, but stun breaks, ranged weapons, and vigor can make surviving the fight easier. Being defeated does not reset the boss's health and the player will respawn close by.
At 75%, the wyvern will shield itself and begin rapidly healing itself with three Recharging Crystals each guarded by a Branded Priest, a Branded Cavalier, and a Branded Priestess — though these mobs don't need to be defeated, just the crystals, which are much easier to destroy than the Empowering Crystals earlier in the mission. During this phase, lightning still periodically strikes the area, and the wyvern periodically breathes lingering spiral circles of Brand. It doesn't matter how quickly the crystals are destroyed as Aurene will breathe a line of divine fire, undoing its healing and stunning it for a short period of time.
At 50%, the wyvern's shielded phase repeats.
At 25%, Aurene will breathe another path of fire, permanently stunning the Branded Wyvern. At this point, it takes massively increased damage.

== Walkthrough ==
Meet Sayida the Sly south of the Mordant Crescent Great Hall. After a brief discussion, she will make you her prisoner, which applies the Shackled effect, and lead you to the front gate. Warden Amala will emerge from the hall and, once Sayida has made a deal with her, knock you out. You will awaken in a cell room, and Zaeim, another prisoner will give you a brief on what happened. You will need to find a way to escape your cell, with each profession having a different way of breaking out:

 Mesmers can interact with the Cell Bars to gain the Blink skill.
 Rangers can interact with the Remains to gain the Vermin Call skill that can be used to destroy the Cell Door Lock.
 Revenants can channel the power of the Legendary Prisoner Palawa Joko to escape.
 Warriors can channel their rage and punch through the bars.
 Guardians can use Hammer of Unchaining to smash their way out.
 Elementalists can Conjure Slag Axe to melt the cell bars.
 Thieves can pick the lock.
 Engineers can interact with the debris to remove cell bar hinges.
 Necromancers can summon a Flesh Wurm to use Necrotic Traversal.
Only the instance owner can use their appropriate method above.
Once you've made it out of your cell, take the nearby's Jailer's key and unlock Zaeim's gate. Grab your equipment from a nearby weapon rack and join Zaeim in escaping the dungeon. At this point you can interact with the book 101 Things the Mordant Crescent Doesn't Want You to Know! next to a corpse in one of the cells for the Library Detective achievement.
The path outside will be riddled with Awakened forces - try and avoid their line of sight, indicated by a white radius in front of them. If you are seen (by entering the radius), you will have to fight the Awakened forces. Climb the final set of stairs and unlock the gate. Once you've gone through the gate, you'll enter a large hall, where a fight is taking place between members of the Sly Crew and Warden Amala.
Warden Amala will be transforming throughout the fight, calling upon different human gods. In the first phase (occurring between 100 and 85% health) she will leap across the room, creating circular AoE attacks, as well as occasionally blocking. Once she reached 85% health, she will have a break bar that you can break. If broken, she will be stunned for a short period of time. Regardless, she will call upon Lyssa, creating multiple clones inside the room. An easy way to identify the "real" Amala is by the legendary rank border around her icon in the UI. She will continue teleporting and switching places with her clones until you get her to 70% health, at which point she will call upon Melandru. Attacking with her scythe, Amala will spawn several AoEs that knock back. At 55% health, the power of Dwayna will be called upon, attacking with various lightning AoEs that inflict daze. At 40% health, she will call upon Grenth, using more leaping attacks and grasping hands to inflict bleeding and crippled. As her final phase, which she enters at 25% health, she will call upon Balthazar, forming multiple fiery AoE attacks that can quickly fill up the room. Finish her off and obtain your communicator from her in order to talk to Taimi, who will brief you on what happened before being interrupted by Palawa Joko.
Sayida the Sly will expect payment for her help, so talk to her and give her the coin. Go outside the hall into the courtyard which is being defended by Awakened forces. Alongside Zaeim, Sunspear and Sly crew members, clear the defending forces. Talk to Rytlock to finish the story.

== Trivia ==
The imprisoned storyteller is a reference to the position of 'dungeon master' in Dungeons & Dragons, and the third line in its dialogue specifically references the long-running Dungeons & Dragons livestream Critical Role.
The following effects are applied to the players while in the dungeon, even though they appear to not have any actual effects: Unease, Apprehension, Dread, and Panic.

Sandswept Isles is a zone available via Living World Season 4 episode A Bug in the System. They are a series of islands on the southern end of Dajkah. The northern island is inhabited by the Olmakhan tribe of charr, while the southern island houses the gargantuan Inquest facility, Rata Primus.


== Getting there ==
The Living World Season 4 episode A Bug in the System is required to access this zone.
Complete the Story mission A Kindness Repaid from Living World Season 4, episode 2: A Bug in the System.
Using Sandswept Isles Portal Scroll.
Using Teleport to Friend on a party member in the zone, if the Living World episode has been unlocked.
Using the Portal to Tyria within Thousand Seas Pavilion.

== Walkthrough ==
When you enter the instance, there is an Inquest console to the left; interact with it to reset the password. This first area is guarded by drones similar to those in the previous story step.  Standing around the orange circle surrounding a drone will cause it to attack.
Each Gate Controller will open one of the gates. Going from controller to controller and through each gate is the straightforward path. There are consoles with fluff text and Inquest on the sides.
After the first few gates, there are consoles to the left and right guarded by Inquest; the left has an Inquest Console that allows you to disable the guard drones (if you reset the password at the start), which will complete the Drones Disabled achievement.
Take the elevator up. Before the first door there are 2 consoles; on the left is a dead charr, on the right there is a control for the Inquest-Specimen Liberator achievement – make sure to hit all the consoles in this room for the achievement, and select the option to "Release control specimen" when available. After the Mysterious Charr breaks through the glass, defeat all the golems to spawn the elevator controller.
Listen to the message on the console. When finished,you can take the elevator up. Jump off the platform circled in green to finish the instance. You'll land safely even if you don't have access to a glider.
When you complete the instance, you are immediately moved into the next story instance, A Kindness Repaid.

Complete the instance.

This is done by firstly setting the access password to "password" using the first console you come to in the instance, then navigate through the first floor almost up to the elevator without being detected by drones (you can use teleports), and disable the drones using the panel in a side room on the left with two inquest, using the option named "Access drone controls".
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Drones Disabled effect.  To complete the achievement, no party members can be detected by the drones, even if they aren't the instance owner.

This includes the drones that are disabled, and thus made unattackable, by completing Drones Disabled, making the two achievements mutually exclusive.
This also includes the unaggressive Inquest on the floor after taking the second elevator.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Inquest Redundancies effect.

Release the healthy control specimens from lab Sigma-05.
These are located on the floor after taking the first elevator. Interact with all Inquest Consoles and select the option to "Access specimen containment controls." then "Release control specimen." when available.
Contrary to the achievement description, some seemingly healthy specimens do not have interactable Consoles and can't be released.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Inquest-Specimen Liberator effect.

== Walkthrough ==
The entrance to the story instance is in the canyon south of  Lommuld Kraal Waypoint —  in the Desert Highlands.
The first few minutes is mostly dialogue, simply follow Boticca once she begins moving to Atholma and the Elders' chamber. After the dialogue there, head to the beach to find the three charr cubs on the small spiral peninsula. After a brief dialogue, you will fight three Olmakhan Sand Elementals, followed by one Elite Olmakhan Sand Effigy. Winning or losing this fight doesn't matter, though it does alter dialogue. After another brief dialogue, Inquest golems will begin attacking, and the real mission starts.
You will have to follow Braham as he escorts the three cubs back to the village's beach toward the Elder Chamber. You do not need to worry about any golems killing the NPCs, as they're invulnerable due to Braham's shield. Periodically, the NPCs' progress will be halted by Enhanced Mark I Phalanx Golem. These golems are innately invulnerable. To defeat them, first kill the Mark III Power Golems that spawn. Doing so will drop bundles that, when picked up, will trigger a Special action skill which stacks up to four times. Use this skill on the Enhanced Mark I Phalanx Golem to make their Unstable Inquest Power Core exposed, and destroy the power core to kill the golem. Do this, and kill any other golem that comes near you, until you reach the beach.
At the beach, Rox will show up saying the Olmakhan need help at the Elder's chamber. Head there, and you will face off against the instance's final boss: Mark II Beta Exterminator Golem. The fight with this golem is essentially an extended and extremely tedious version of the fight against Enhanced Mark I Phalanx Golems from earlier. Attacking directly will cause very small amount of damage. Instead, kill the Mark II Power Golems that spawn, use the charges from the bundles they drop to damage the Exterminator Golem, and after every four charges the Unstable Exterminator Core will be exposed and you can attack it. At 33% health, the Power Golems stop spawning and you must attack the golem directly until it reaches approximately 10% health, where it will spawn its power core again, and you can finish it off.
Some notes on the final boss fight (some of the bugs *may* have been fixed):

Ranger pets don't draw aggro and are continuously oneshotted by the AoE attacks of the Exterminator.
Enemies will target you even when stealthed. [verification requested]

Once the Exterminator Golem is defeated, another brief dialogue will play, and the instance is completed.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the mission.

Walk through the cabbages outside the village, just north of Malor's Ranch on the map.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Cabbage Shredder effect.

Kill the Elite Sand Effigy the children summon. Players can complete this achievement by using ranged attacks on the Effigy. If hit by a short range earth shockwave, the player is defeated by the Youth and the achievement must be reattempted.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Impressionable Youth effect.

Defeat the Mark II Beta Exterminator Golem in under three minutes. Players can complete this achievement by using their special action on the Golem when it has stacks of protection. Players can acquire the special action charges from defeated support Golems. After removing all of the stacks, the Golem Core is ejected and players can do increased damage to the Golem by targeting the Core.
There are several steps you can take to complete this achievement more easily:
Note, the special action applies 25 stacks Vulnerability (increases damage taken) after shielding is removed (boss), or if there is no shielding (core).
Collect four charges of the special action before entering the council chamber. The Power Golems that drop these charges only spawn during the cub escort part of the mission when Braham is blocked by Phalanx Golems (occurs 3 times). However, the Power Golems spawn an infinite number of times during these parts so you can kill them over and over. You can even leave charges on the ground to collect later just in case.
When the timer starts, defeat the support golems first so they drop charges. Otherwise, they will shoot you and not drop any charge, forcing you to wait until the next phase. You cannot pick up the charges yet, since you can only store four charges at the same time.
Spend all four charges to remove the exterminator golem's four stacks, then get as much damage done on the core as possible. Try not to get hit by the core's explosions, they may cause it to immediately jump back into the golem, forcing you to break the shielding again.
After the core jumps back into the golem, pick up the charges left behind by the support golems and spend them all again. This will allow you to immediately attack the core again without waiting for new support golem spawns.
Once the golem is down to 33 percent health, you can attack it directly. When it spits out the core, you can finish it off.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  X-T3R-M1N-8 effect.

== Walkthrough ==
The entrance to the story instance is in the canyon south of  Lommuld Kraal Waypoint — . Once inside, speak to Agent Kito and then to Braham/Rox.

Ambush an Inquest convoy and capture a transport golem.
The Inquest convoy (a transport golem and two guards) will enter from the northeast with some prisoners. Once you've defeated the convoy, the instance owner will be able to enter the golem (which will turn all other players into assault cubes[verification requested]). Once Braham and Rox agree to be chained up, approach the waterfall, enter and make your way to the first set of doors.
Use   Tech Overload on the door panel once it becomes unlocked. Proceed through the doors and stop by the conveyor belt on the right to deposit your "prisoners". The next set of doors will then open and you may proceed.

Covertly navigate the Inquest station and find the Tracking Network Hub.
The goal here is to use Tech Overload on panels (marked with green gears) to disable certain laser fields. The facility is also populated with drones that have 2 main behaviours:

If the transport golem enters the orange circle around a drone, inquest suspicion will increase and you will be prompted by the Inquest with one of 3 possible responses:
You can try to pass off as Inquest. This will disengage the drone's detection circle.
Excelsior! This will disengage the drone's detection circle and increase the inquest suspicion bar by 1/3. (Always excelsior, a generic answer for any race)
You can engage the Inquest in the room in combat (which also happens if the timer runs out).
If the Inquest Suspicion bar fills all the way and you are detected, you will not be asked any question and immediately enter combat.
Note that other players in the party will be able to stun the drones temporarily, preventing them from detecting nearby golems.
Any time you overload a panel, the closest drone will head directly towards it. Once the drone reaches the panel, there will be an audible cue and the laser field will be re-enabled 5 seconds later.
The first 3 rooms will only require that you overload one panel/one set of lasers to unblock passage to the next room.
As you ascend the stairs after the 3rd set of lasers, Taimi will unlock the golem's second skill,   Golem Stealth Generator, which will let the golem stealth for 16 seconds (provided the player doesn't move). Use this skill to let drones pass by without being detected.
The 4th room requires that you overload both panels (to disable the lasers at both the top and bottom of the stairs).  If you only disable one laser and try to run through it will be reactivated behind you.  You will need to kill yourself and restart at the checkpoint if this happens.
In the 5th room at the top of the stairs, you will need to overload the panel on the left to disable the lasers next to the other panel on the right. This is the only passage available to you if you're trying to avoid suspicion (there's another path available that requires defeating 2 stationary drones).
Descend the next set of stairs to the 6th room; here, you'll need to overload either one of the two panels to enter the sectioned-off room (containing another panel) at the base of the next set of stairs; overload this third panel to unblock the stairs. Go up the stairs to the 7th (and final) room and head to the end.
Given the slow patrol paths of the golems and their random timing, it will often be faster to simply kill everything in a room rather waiting for the patrols to get into appropriate positions for you to disable the gates and run through them in time.  You will need a sufficiently tough character to handle the large number of golems and Inquest that attack you. 

Access the Tracking Network Hub.
 Wait until Braham and Rox get off the conveyor belt and make your way to the Tracking Network Hub. Use   Exit Golem to exit the golem and interact with the hub. The Tracking Networking Authentication requires that each of the 3 input colors, when superimposed, fill all parts of the pattern without any overlap. Interact with the three buttons to change the sequence for one of each of the individual colors until there are no overlaps. Interact with the Tracking Network Hub and enter the asura gate once it has opened.
If failed over and over, golems will attack you.  Killing them solves the puzzle. 
When you complete the instance, you are immediately moved into the next story instance, The Test Subject.

== Trivia ==
The discussion between the researchers about the decommissioned Exterminator model is likely a reference to a similar conversation regarding speeder models in Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope and its call-back in Rogue One. Both happen during segments where the heroes being focused on are either being stealthy or disguised.

The Domain of Kourna is a zone available via Living World Season 4 episode Long Live the Lich. 
It is a part of the Crystal Desert, located to the south of the Domain of Vabbi. It is known to be the heart of the mad Palawa Joko's kingdom, making civilizations that are housed in that land nearby unsafe. Many have become influenced by Joko and started following him.

Complete the Story mission Forearmed is Forewarned from Living World Season 4, episode 3: Long Live the Lich.
Using Domain of Kourna Portal Scroll.

== Walkthrough ==
Pick your way through the court dialogue options (see "Loquacious Orator" below), free Gorrik with the key, and then meet Lord Faren by the docks.
After some more dialogue there is an introduction to a new mechanic: squishing bugs. You can either do this (a) on foot by jumping on them, (b) on a mount by running them over, or (c) on a roller beetle mount. (Using a roller beetle is the fastest method but is only available after playing through the story once before and completing the collection.) Squish all of the marshmallow bugs as indicated by the green stars to continue.
Meet Faren at dock six to play a cinematic, whereupon the scarab plague arrives on the boat. Squish the scarab plague bugs with your mount. Take the opportunity afterwards to move some of the rocks on the ground to the northwest side of the small square - you may find them useful for the breakbar shortly. Joko's Projection then animates some newly deceased locals. Kill them, and then fight the Elite Istari the Inexorable. Several times during the first phase of the fight, Istari moves to a nearby corpse and gains a breakbar - break it to interrrupt her. There is a pause in the fight at 50%, where more locals appear —Aurene backs you up with some dragon fire— and then Istari traps you in a spell ring forcing you to fight her unto death.
Listen to the remaining dialogue to complete the mission. Optionally there is a statue you may destroy in the hold of the boat.

== Walkthrough ==
At the start of the instance, you can immediately run across the bridge or fight as you go. You will need to defeat several waves of Awakened before triggering a cutscene. Afterward, simply follow Braham and the path until you reach the torture chamber.
To exit the torture chamber, interact with the signet ring. Interacting with the ring object provides the special action skill   ?????. Using the skill provides the King's Sight effect which temporarily dispels Joko's illusions. While King's Sight is active, circles on the wall with a whip pattern will glow. Interact with the circle to turn it. Once the pattern is whole again (the pattern on the outer ring matches with the pattern on the inner ring to make a whole symbol), you can continue. These circles will appear again throughout the story instance to turn off traps so that Braham can follow you.
The following hallway has fire tiles on the floor that catch fire consistently and repeatedly. Make sure not to spend too long on any of the empty tiles, as they will also catch fire if you stand on them for too long (shown on the floor as an expanding red square within the tile). There are some tiles with sparks, indicating that the trap tile is "not working" and are safe to stand on. The wall circle stone is at the end of the hallway. This one takes multiple turns to match the pattern. Completing the pattern on all of the necessary circles results in the traps being turned off, so Braham will appear in the next room with you after a moment.
After talking with Joko in the next room, make sure you activate the signet ring again. There are lasers to pass by, which are only visible with King's Sight. In order to pass through the walls of lasers, make sure to only move through the ones that are dim (which changes every couple of seconds, so move quickly through each laser set). There are three wall circles in the hallway; be sure to interact with all of them in order to disable the traps.
After the next talk with Joko (+ fight), the following hallway has both lasers and fire floor tiles. These both function exactly as the previous two did, but the combination means that you need to be able to move quickly through the whole hallway. Don't forget the multiple wall circles.
In the Contaminarium, there is a central wall with a symbol on it. There are 4 circles set within the symbol, which are connected with lasers to 4 pillars in front of them (lasers only visible via King's Sight. The circles must be turned to complete the symbol by interacting with the small pillars that correspond to each circle. Ignore Braham's musings on what looks right; the view without King's Sight is not correct.
The fight in the Contaminarium with Beastmarshal Oluwa Eranko can be tricky. Make sure to keep King's Sight active in order to see the lasers on the ground. When the message "The beastmarshal howls for her brood." appears, she summons three small Abominable Whelps to help her. To break her out of her howling, you can hit her with a bone to instantly break her defiance bar. She teleports between the four corners of the room on the fire floor tiles; be sure to not stand on those when you engage her, when possible.
The final fight with Palawa Joko can take a while. The metal flooring in the middle of the room is fire tiles which activate after a second or two, shown by the expanding red square in each tile. When Joko disappears (95%, 80% health) use the signet ring to see Will of Joko(s), which can only be seen and attacked when using King's Sight. They will explode on death, but also die instantly if broken. A bone from around the room can be used to kill each one instantly. After each Will of Joko phase, another Royal Guard will be summoned, and all the previous ones resurrected with low health, indicated by the text "Joko Awakens the fallen." After the second Will of Joko phase, Bloated Plague Scarabs will begin to spawn. These creatures will follow you until they get into melee range, at which point they will explode. At 50%, during the third Will of Joko phase, a message saying "The plague scarabs coalesce." appears, which means that a huge purple wall of plague will begin to make its way across the room, from the opening towards the windows. In order to survive the wall, make sure you have King's Sight active in order to see a gap in the wall to pass through safely. During the next phase of the battle with Joko, he uses large AoE rings that extend out from him and the  Aura of the Vampire effect, draining life from you. After another Will of Joko phase and another Joko phase down to 10% health, he teleports to the front of the fire floor tiles and speaks briefly. Once he is whittled down to 0% health, he will teleport near the windows again to play dead, while the player has the  Stasis effect. After you check the body, the ending plays.
The order of phases for the final battle and what appears in them is as follows:

Palawa Joko 100% -> 95% heath
Will of Joko (1)
Palawa Joko 95% -> 80% + Royal Guard (1)
Will of Joko (2)
Palawa Joko 80% -> 50% + Royal Guard (1) + Plague Scarabs
Will of Joko (3) + wall
Palawa Joko 50% -> 25% + Royal Guard (2) + Plague Scarabs
Will of Joko (4) + wall
Palawa Joko 25% -> 10% + Royal Guard (4) + Plague Scarabs
Palawa Joko 10% -> 0%

== Trivia ==
In earlier drafts of the story instance Turai Ossa was going to appear in ghost form to gloat over Joko's defeat. It did not fit the cinematic version of that moment in the final version of the script, however, so his role was removed.
The "ancient skill signet" is likely a reference to an early concept for the original Guild Wars, in which skills were to be represented by eight rings worn on the main fingers. Though this concept was eventually scrapped, remnants remain in the final product: the limit of eight skills at a time, and the skill type "signet", named for the ring.


== References ==

Sun's Refuge is an instance accessible to players in Living World Season 4, episode 4: A Star to Guide Us. Though well-hidden and largely forgotten by humans, this ancient cavern has nonetheless seen several uses throughout its existence: as a shrine to the goddess Melandru, as a cistern for the Elon's floodwaters, and 250 years ago, as a sanctuary for the Order of the Sunspears during their campaign to prevent Nightfall. Now, history repeats itself as the Sunspears once again make their home here. The instance changes based on the player's progress and actions in the Living World, and functions as a content hub. After completing Legacy, the third part of A Star to Guide Us during Living World Season 4, access to Sun's Refuge is unlocked for all characters on that account.

== Notes ==

Sun's Refuge builds on the vision and idea of how the home instance was originally going to be before time constraints forced developers to simplify the latter.
There are no large scale plans to add to the instance going forward.
The items given to Aurene for Cultural Attaché are arrayed around her nest. If the collection is not completed, the surrounding slots will be empty.
The crystals collected for Naja will be added to the display case next to her.
The diving spot in Sun's Refuge can be found east of the music golem.


== Trivia ==

The pillars of robed figures in the middle section are similar to others found throughout the Crystal Desert and Elona in both games. They seem to be of Forgotten origin due to their appearance in Lair of the Forgotten.


== References ==

Legacy is the third part of A Star to Guide Us during Living World Season 4.

== Walkthrough ==
Clearing the Santuary
Meet up with Braham, Kossan, and Koss inside the instance. Use your raptor to leap across the bridge, then interact with the Drawbridge Mechanism to allow your allies to cross. Make your way south until you reach a corridor blocked by spider webs, and instruct Kossan to destroy them. Several spiders will spawn, freaking out Braham and hinting at how your next ten minutes are going to go.
Kossan will attempt to light the brazier inside the Sanctuary, spawning more spiders. After killing a few, Kossan will instruct you to take Braham and clear out the other braziers of webs. A timer will appear, but aside from an achievement, there's no mission penalty for letting it run out. Follow one of the arrows on the map to one of the three braziers and clear out the three Egg Sacs, causing the Colossal Broodmother to spawn. Take her down to 75% and she will burrow away. Braham will start clearing the webs, but his arachnophobia will keep getting the better of him: use your special action skill   Braham, focus! to snap him back to his senses.
When he's finished clearing the webs, the Broodmother will return to gobble you both up. This cannot be prevented, and you cannot escape her clutches until she's ready to put you down.   Break Free will pop up on your skill bar at random; failure to press it before it moves again will result in you taking damage. The Broodmother will carry you off to one of the other braziers. Bring her down by another 25% and continue as before. When all three braziers have been cleared, the Broodmother will carry you back to the Dejarins. Finish her off along with the rest of the spiders, then light the Center Brazier.

Fending off the Branded
After your allies have had a chance to chat, head north into the Old Command Post to find a large rift belching Branded enemies into the area. Clear them out and a cutscene will play, spawning a Legendary Branded Riftstalker and two new allies: Eir and Snaff.
The Riftstalker telegraphs its attacks clearly. A storm of AoE will litter the arena; try to avoid these, as they will add stacks of  Branded Accumulation — at ten stacks, you will be encased in a Branded crystal. At 66% and 33% the Riftstalker will turn invulnerable and spawn several Branded Pods: destroy these, and any Branded Riftcrawlers that pop out of them if you're not fast enough, to make the Riftstalker vulnerable again.
Once it's dead, follow your allies back into the Refuge to discuss your options and watch another cutscene.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the story step.

Spam   Braham, focus! to ensure Braham gets his job done swiftly.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Is It Over Yet? effect.

While the Broodmother has swallowed you, use   Break Free as it pops up on your skill bar to prevent her from dealing damage to you.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Not Today effect.

Don't let your  Branded Accumulation reach 10 stacks. Standing in the small AoEs will apply a stack; dodging removes a stack.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Unbranded effect.

Two sets of pods will spawn: three at 66%, and six at 33%. A red circular timer will appear above each pod to indicate how long it has until it detonates.
Destroying all six pods at the 33% phase can be tricky to solo. When the Riftstalker nears 33%, move near one of the edges of the rift so you will be near the first pod when it spawns; you can then make your way through the pods in order to save time.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Pod Smasher effect.

== Walkthrough ==
After starting the episode, head towards the Vehtendi Vineyard in the Domain of Vabbi. Look for the green star and speak with Braham to enter the instance.
Follow Braham to the Jahai Great Hall. After a short dialogue, interact with Aurene. Wait until the dialogue is over, then speak with the four delegates.
After calming the delegates, walk into the center and listen to the dialogue. Then Iberu will pull you towards him and tries to kill all the delegates, but Koss runs in and kills him. Listen to the dialogue, then walk towards north.
The Shatterer will land outside the hall and fear you away. Follow the green arrow to escort the delegates out of the room. Listen to Hierarch Chikere about his plan, and after he is killed, enter the next room.
There are 3 free Awakened citizens in the first room. Use the   Move! special action skill to call them to your position. You must move them to the red arrow while the Shatterer is attacking the room with AoEs. Then enter the next room, defeat the Branded, and head forward.
3 free Awakened are trapped in crystals in this room. Avoid the Shatterer's attacks and destroy the crystals to free the citizens, then use the   Move! special action skill as above. Then enter the next room, kill the Branded foes, and move on.
The Shatterer will appear outside this room after a short dialogue. Beware of its fear attack, and call the citizens (3 more in this room) towards the red arrow as above.
Enter the next room, and defeat Death-Branded Hierarch Chikere. Afterwards listen to the dialogue, destroy the crystal wall in front of you, and go outside. Watch Aurene and the Shatterer fly away, and listen to more dialogue. The instance ends when the dialogue is finished.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the instance.

Avoid getting struck by any of the Death-Branded Shatterers claw attacks.
The Death-Branded Shatterer will use its claw attacks only for the first and second room containing Free Awakened Citizens.
Can be achieved in the same try as Splat!.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Claws to the Wall effect.

Rescue all 9 Free Awakened Citizens during your escape through the fortress, there are:
3 in the first room after Hierarch Chikere gets killed by the Death-Branded Shatterer
3 entombed in Branding Crystals, in the room right after fighting the Veteran Branded Awakened Archer
3 in the room after fighting the Veteran Branded Awakened Ravager, right before fighting Death-Branded Hierarch Chikere
During your escape you only have to worry about the Death-Branded Shatterers claw attacks, its fear attack deals no damage to the Free Awakened Citizens. The various Branded Awakened that spawn will neither target nor deal damage to the Free Awakened. Death-Branded Hierarch Chikere is an exception, he will target and damage them, but he cannot kill them as they get invulnerable when reaching 1% health.
For the first group, the easiest way to save all of them is to first destroy the Unstable Crystal Wall blocking the exit of the room. After that observe the room and find safe positions, where the Death-Branded Shatterers attacks can't reach you. Move your character into a safe position, wait for the Death-Branded Shatterer to do its claw attack and then call the Free Awakened Citizens to your position, repeat this until they all have reached the room's exit.
For the second group, focus on destroying the Branding Crystals. The trapped awakened will become Branded Free Awakened if the crystals are not destroyed quickly enough.
For the third group, just destroy the Unstable Crystal Wall. The Death-Branded Shatterer will only use its fear attack in this room, so you can just lead all of your Free Awakened Citizens to the exit.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for In Tatters; Not Shattered effect.

During "Escort the delegates out of the summit room", when Hierarch Chikere suggest using the Free Awakened trapped inside the next room as a distraction, stand next to him and get struck by the Death-Branded Shatterer's claws.
(Aegis and skills that Block or grant you Invulnerability will prevent you from unlocking this achievement.)
Can be achieved in the same try as Claws to the Wall.

== Walkthrough ==
First instance
Enter Sun's Refuge, approach the NPCs and trigger the dialogue. Help Rytlock to relight the sword with the   Relight Balthazar's Sword special action skill when the time comes.

Second instance
Mount up and run to the area just beyond the archway. Kill the waves of Branded - Balthazar's Sword will help fight foes in range, and avoid Branded Crystals which inflict  Encased on impact.
When the Branded are defeated, pick up the sword and plant it in the ground to allow Blish to repair the tracker. This time the sword goes aggressive to everything, including you. Jump over any shockwaves generated and avoid the AoE fields whilst fighting further Branded. Glint will eventually urge you to leave, at which point try to get out of combat as you follow the arrow.
With Kralkatorrik now approaching, mount up on a Raptor (useful combination of ability to jump over debris/canyons and move reasonably fast). Follow the aspect of Glint through the ruins, using orbs of volatile magic to recharge your endurance. Be careful not to stray too far to the sides which is very easy to do with the Raptor jump — if you jump too far to the sides you can easily hit the edges of the instance and be instantly kicked out before you can pull back. There are two points where the path seems to run out and you are pushed backwards by strong winds — keep going when the next section loads.
In the next section you will jump over normal platforms at first, but then you will be placed into a disorienting area with low-gravity effects similar to those encountered in the Shattered Observatory. The low gravity makes this a tedious and difficult jumping puzzle because your momentum and speed are completely changed from anything normal. Unlike every other part of the mission there are no map markers to indicate the direction you must take, fortunately visually tracking the floating islands is clear. You must hit every one of the floating islands or else you will lack momentum to make the next and die. The lack of a real background makes perspective and judging distances and especially your height even more difficult. Your speed and angle through the air is effected by pressing the jump button and the direction of you camera. Hold down space as much as possible to maintain your speed but it is very possible to overshoot platforms. To land on a platform if it looks like you will overshoot, turn your camera down and stop pressing jump. If you are low enough over a platform you can gauge your position by the shadow of your Raptor, this is the only orientation possible in the are without any other points of reference for height.
On top of everything, this is a timed jumping puzzle with the insta-kill storm rapidly moving in, if it reaches you, you will die. You cannot pause for a moment to re-orient but must keep moving every second. If you die (which can happen multiple times as with any timed jumping puzzle) you will be sent back to the beginning, as there are no checkpoints in this section.
Note: In spite of the mission explicitly telling you to use the Raptor, you can switch mounts so if you have unlocked the Griffon, use it instead of the Raptor!
Once you get far enough, Glint will open a rift and you can finally leave.

Third instance
Enter the final instance and speak to your allies. After a lot of dialogue the mission will complete.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the instance.

If you reach the area before Blish does you will have a big advantage of time to kill the Branded.
The achievement will be awarded upon completing the "Blish's Progress Bar".
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Right On Track effect.

The required time is 3:30.
You should be at about 2:30 when the first wind push happens and about 1:30 when the second wind push happens.
Try to be fast, but don't rush it, as there are some tight jumps and fails are very punishing.
Flying mounts like griffon or skyscale can be helpful after the second wind push.
If you fail the achievement, exit the instance and re-enter; you will be returned directly to the start of the run.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Achievement Eligibility: Raptor Out effect.

Awarded after escaping Kralkatorrik in the mists.

The Jahai Bluffs is a zone available via Living World Season 4 episode A Star to Guide Us.
It is where Palawa Joko was defeated by Turai Ossa at the Battle of Jahai. Located inbetween the Domain of Vabbi and the Domain of Kourna, it houses the grand Fortress of Jahai as well as multiple villages, some of which have either been abandoned after Palawa Joko took over, or destroyed in more recent times due to Kralkatorrik's Dragonbrand.
After the Battle of Kodash Bazaar, the Elder Dragon Kralkatorrik had flown over part of this land, spreading the Dragonbrand, and leaving behind anomalies in time and space.


== Getting there ==
The Living World Season 4 episode A Star to Guide Us is required to access this zone.
Complete the Story mission A Shattered Nation from Living World Season 4, episode 4: A Star to Guide Us.
From Domain of Vabbi: The portal is behind a painting of Joko, in the room with High Elder Yitfei the Light at the Vehtendi Vineyard. Limited by story progression.
From Domain of Kourna: The portal is at the end of the path leading up the cliffs south of Dunlon Springs. Limited by story progression, otherwise invisible.
Using Jahai Bluffs Portal Scroll, Sun's Refuge Portal Scroll or Spearmarshal's Plea to Sun's Refuge after unlocking it on one character.
Using Teleport to Friend on a party member in the zone, if the Living World episode has been unlocked.

== Walkthrough ==
First instance
Enter Sun's Refuge, approach the NPCs and trigger the dialogue. Help Rytlock to relight the sword with the   Relight Balthazar's Sword special action skill when the time comes.

Second instance
Mount up and run to the area just beyond the archway. Kill the waves of Branded - Balthazar's Sword will help fight foes in range, and avoid Branded Crystals which inflict  Encased on impact.
When the Branded are defeated, pick up the sword and plant it in the ground to allow Blish to repair the tracker. This time the sword goes aggressive to everything, including you. Jump over any shockwaves generated and avoid the AoE fields whilst fighting further Branded. Glint will eventually urge you to leave, at which point try to get out of combat as you follow the arrow.
With Kralkatorrik now approaching, mount up on a Raptor (useful combination of ability to jump over debris/canyons and move reasonably fast). Follow the aspect of Glint through the ruins, using orbs of volatile magic to recharge your endurance. Be careful not to stray too far to the sides which is very easy to do with the Raptor jump — if you jump too far to the sides you can easily hit the edges of the instance and be instantly kicked out before you can pull back. There are two points where the path seems to run out and you are pushed backwards by strong winds — keep going when the next section loads.
In the next section you will jump over normal platforms at first, but then you will be placed into a disorienting area with low-gravity effects similar to those encountered in the Shattered Observatory. The low gravity makes this a tedious and difficult jumping puzzle because your momentum and speed are completely changed from anything normal. Unlike every other part of the mission there are no map markers to indicate the direction you must take, fortunately visually tracking the floating islands is clear. You must hit every one of the floating islands or else you will lack momentum to make the next and die. The lack of a real background makes perspective and judging distances and especially your height even more difficult. Your speed and angle through the air is effected by pressing the jump button and the direction of you camera. Hold down space as much as possible to maintain your speed but it is very possible to overshoot platforms. To land on a platform if it looks like you will overshoot, turn your camera down and stop pressing jump. If you are low enough over a platform you can gauge your position by the shadow of your Raptor, this is the only orientation possible in the are without any other points of reference for height.
On top of everything, this is a timed jumping puzzle with the insta-kill storm rapidly moving in, if it reaches you, you will die. You cannot pause for a moment to re-orient but must keep moving every second. If you die (which can happen multiple times as with any timed jumping puzzle) you will be sent back to the beginning, as there are no checkpoints in this section.
Note: In spite of the mission explicitly telling you to use the Raptor, you can switch mounts so if you have unlocked the Griffon, use it instead of the Raptor!
Once you get far enough, Glint will open a rift and you can finally leave.

Third instance
Enter the final instance and speak to your allies. After a lot of dialogue the mission will complete.


=== Achievements ===

Complete the instance.

If you reach the area before Blish does you will have a big advantage of time to kill the Branded.
The achievement will be awarded upon completing the "Blish's Progress Bar".
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Qualify for Right On Track effect.

The required time is 3:30.
You should be at about 2:30 when the first wind push happens and about 1:30 when the second wind push happens.
Try to be fast, but don't rush it, as there are some tight jumps and fails are very punishing.
Flying mounts like griffon or skyscale can be helpful after the second wind push.
If you fail the achievement, exit the instance and re-enter; you will be returned directly to the start of the run.
Achievement qualification may be tracked via the  Achievement Eligibility: Raptor Out effect.

Awarded after escaping Kralkatorrik in the mists.
